description: This file implements the 'git notes' command as a collection of subcommands for managing notes in Git; it includes functions for listing, adding, copying, editing, showing, merging, removing, pruning, and retrieving references to notes. It defines external dependencies, handles user options, and contains logic for note manipulation and merging workflows.

methods.name: void free_note_data(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a note_msg and cleans up related buffers.

methods.name: int list_each_note(const struct object_id * object_oid,const struct object_id * note_oid,char * note_path UNUSED,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Prints the note OID and object OID for each note in the repository.

methods.name: void copy_obj_to_fd(int fd,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads an object from the odb and writes it to a file descriptor.

methods.name: void write_commented_object(int fd,const struct object_id * object)
methods.description: Uses 'git show' to get object details and writes the output with comments.

methods.name: void prepare_note_data(const struct object_id * object,struct note_data * d,const struct object_id * old_note)
methods.description: Prepares note data, including launching editor or reusing note objects.

methods.name: void write_note_data(struct note_data * d,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Writes note data to the object database.

methods.name: void append_separator(struct strbuf * message)
methods.description: Appends paragraph separators to a message buffer.

methods.name: void concat_messages(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Concatenates multiple note messages into a single buffer.

methods.name: int parse_msg_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses message argument from command-line options.

methods.name: int parse_file_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a file argument and loads its content into a note message.

methods.name: int parse_reuse_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Loads existing object data into a note message for reusing.

methods.name: int parse_reedit_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets a flag to use editor for reediting notes.

methods.name: int parse_separator_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets paragraph separator string.

methods.name: int notes_copy_from_stdin(int force,const char * rewrite_cmd)
methods.description: Copies notes between objects based on stdin input or rewrite command.

methods.name: struct:notes_tree * init_notes_check(const char * subcommand,int flags)
methods.description: Initializes notes workspace with validation of refs.

methods.name: int list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Lists notes associated with objects; supports optional object argument.

methods.name: int append_edit(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles editing or appending notes to objects, with relevant options.

methods.name: int add(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Adds or updates notes for a specified object, with options for message, file, or reuse.

methods.name: int copy(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Copies notes from one object to another, supporting stdin and rewrite options.

methods.name: int show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Shows the note for a specified object, if it exists.

methods.name: int merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts a notes merge, cleaning up refs and worktree.

methods.name: int merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Finalizes a notes merge and updates refs accordingly.

methods.name: int git_config_get_notes_strategy(const char * key,enum notes_merge_strategy * strategy)
methods.description: Reads and parses the notes merge strategy from config.

methods.name: int merge(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles merging of notes, including conflicts, options for strategy, and commit/abort actions.

methods.name: int remove_one_note(struct notes_tree * t,const char * name,unsigned flag)
methods.description: Removes a note for a given object, with potential ignore-missing flag.

methods.name: int remove_cmd(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Removes notes for multiple objects, possibly from stdin.

methods.name: int prune(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Prunes unreferenced notes, with options for verbosity and dry run.

methods.name: int get_ref(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Prints the current notes ref.

methods.name: int cmd_notes(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main function that dispatches subcommands for 'git notes' based on CLI arguments.
